title: Amazon Bedrock models
description: The Amazon Bedrock model each feature uses. The defaults are the shipped models, or the default profile's; a model chosen here is used instead until it is reset. Enable access to a model in the Amazon Bedrock console before choosing it: this page does not check access, and a feature whose model cannot be invoked reports the error when it runs.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes, to each summary, answer or key frame started after that; one already under way finishes with the model it started with.

inferenceGeography.title: Model inference geography
inferenceGeography.description: Where Amazon Bedrock may run the models below and the Meeting Consent section's evidence check model. Global: each model id is used as chosen, and a global. inference profile may run inference in any commercial AWS Region. Same geography as this deployment: inference stays within the geography of this deployment's Region (the United States, Europe, Canada, Asia Pacific, or Japan, Australia or India where Amazon Bedrock has a profile for that country); a model whose id routes outside it is run as the same model through the geography's inference profile, or as the in-region model. In-region only: inference stays in this deployment's Region, which most Claude models are not offered in on demand. A feature whose model has no id in the selected geography reports an error rather than leaving it; the notice above lists them. Amazon Nova Sonic, the voice assistant, runs in the Region set by the AmazonNovaSonicRegion stack parameter and is not affected.

summaryModelId.title: Summaries and meeting insights
summaryModelId.description: Writes the end-of-meeting summary, reads pasted meeting invitations, names speakers from what they say, derives the agenda, and answers questions over past meeting transcripts.

meetingAssistModelId.title: Meeting assistant
meetingAssistModelId.description: Answers in the meeting assistant chat, for the voice assistant's lookups and for questions typed in the meeting chat, and runs the troubleshooting agent. It answers mid-meeting, so time to the first word matters more here than for summaries.

knowledgeBaseModelId.title: Meeting assistant knowledge bases
knowledgeBaseModelId.description: Writes the answer the document-search and past-meeting-search tools return from what they retrieve. Only models verified to work with a Bedrock knowledge base are offered.

keyframeTextModelId.title: Key frame text
keyframeTextModelId.description: Reads the text of each key frame of the shared screen, once, when the frame is stored. Image-capable models only.
